description: Canonical provisional model-assisted annotation ledger for sentence-level Syntax Reliability.

binary_task.question: Can parser-derived syntax and clause metrics be used for this sentence?

field_meanings.student_id: Pseudonymous learner identifier; never a real name.
field_meanings.source_stage: Corpus or validation stage from which the response originated.
field_meanings.data_status: Current methodological role; Corpus D is development after its holdout result was inspected.
field_meanings.original_text: Exact uncorrected response text used to reproduce parsing.
field_meanings.original_text_sha256: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 original_text value.
field_meanings.repository_commit: Frozen repository revision used for the validation parse.
field_meanings.reliability_version: Frozen heuristic baseline version; not the source of reference annotations.

field_meanings.sentence_id: Stable identifier within an essay and frozen sentence segmentation.
field_meanings.sentence_index: One-based sentence position produced by the frozen spaCy pipeline.
field_meanings.original_text: Exact uncorrected sentence text from frozen segmentation.
field_meanings.manual_label: Historical field name for the four-class provisional model-assisted reference annotation; never derived from heuristic HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW.
field_meanings.usable_binary_label: Provisional ML target: true for RELIABLE/MOSTLY_RELIABLE, false for UNRELIABLE, null for NOT_ANALYZABLE.
field_meanings.abstention_status: Reason an item is excluded from the binary task; none for analyzable labels.
field_meanings.manual_failure_types: Controlled, possibly multi-valued reason codes used only as annotation metadata.
field_meanings.annotation_notes: Explanation produced during model-assisted review; not an ML feature.
field_meanings.annotation_origin: Transparent provenance category for the annotation process.
field_meanings.annotator_id: Transparent identifier for the model-assisted review process, not a human identity.
field_meanings.adjudication_status: Whether the record is single-reviewed, agreed, or human-adjudicated.
field_meanings.adjudicator_id: Required for adjudicated records; transparent identifier for the human dataset owner.
field_meanings.adjudication_date: Required ISO date for adjudicated records.
field_meanings.pre_adjudication_label: Optional valid label preserving the model-assisted label before human adjudication.
field_meanings.adjudication_notes: Optional explanation of a human adjudication decision.
